what: [SCOPE-REDUCTION] Plan changes the Step 5c guard release sentinel away from the current terminal sentinel contract
scenario_or_breakage: `design-step5c.sh` writes `.completed/step-5c` only when `PLAN_WRITE_OK=true`, but writes `.completed/step-5c-terminal` at the terminal wrapper boundary. Changing the hook to wait on `.completed/step-5c` can leave failed publish paths guarded until EXIT cleanup, and can release successful paths before the wrapper reaches its terminal sentinel.
suggested_fix: Keep `design-step5c` hook release on `.completed/step-5c-terminal` and drop the mismatch-fix test/doc edits, unless the plan also makes `.completed/step-5c` the actual terminal sentinel on every terminal Step 5c path.

what: The plan adds a foreground sentinel-probe recovery path but leaves the shared NEVER contract saying the sole premature-notification exception is the background recovery waiter
scenario_or_breakage: `/design` guidance would permit the new probe while the shared orchestrator rule still bans `test` progress-observation calls and says the waiter is the sole sanctioned exception. An orchestrator following both surfaces can still reject the planned recovery path.
suggested_fix: Update the shared NEVER wording with the same narrow foreground completion-sentinel probe carve-out, while preserving the existing bans on progress artifacts, result envs, task outputs, sleep loops, and Monitor.
